hypotheses.F1_routing_profiles_are_low_dimensional: At most 64 weighted principal components explain 90 percent of routing-profile variance in both splits.
hypotheses.F2_read_function_primitives_are_stable: Greedily matched independent NMF read-function vectors have mean cosine at least 0.80.
hypotheses.F3_soft_variable_memberships_are_stable: After component alignment, frequent-token soft membership vectors have weighted mean cosine at least 0.70.
hypotheses.F4_hard_variable_assignments_are_more_st: NMF argmax assignments have weighted NMI at least 0.55 across splits.
hypotheses.F5_hard_nmf_variables_are_causally_usefu: The better independent NMF hard partition reaches at least 0.90 six-layer KL recovery.
hypotheses.F6_hard_nmf_variables_are_prediction_use: The better independent NMF hard partition reaches at least 0.65 native top-1 agreement.
hypotheses.F7_primitive_uses_are_sparse: Median components needed for 90 percent token membership are at most 4 and median coordinates needed for 90 percent function mass are at most 32.
